name: page-canvas
title: Page Canvas
description: The presentation page shell: the page scrolls, content sits in a centered column, a section can run edge to edge, and a header and a contact footer frame the page.
docs: Use for a screen presented to someone, under data-design="presentation". PageCanvas wraps the document; PageSection gives each block a centered column and generous vertical space, and variant="band" runs a raised surface edge to edge. A short head and the section after it meet at --space-8 each, 64px at every width: compact="bottom" on the head, compact="top" after it. PageHeader opens the page: the lockup as its children, at most one action at right, one row a touch target high whoever is on the page. ContactFooter ends it with the public contact the page supplies (address, phone, email); the design system holds no business data. After a band that ends the page (the last section of main, of main's last block, or right before the footer), the band's border is the footer's rule: PageSection variant="band" writes data-band, which ContactFooter reads, so a band of your own needs data-band too. Hierarchy comes from space and elevation. An operations screen uses AppShell instead. See DESIGN.md "Profiles" and "Components".
